name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 78 - Am 48
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 78c. Notes that the United States designated Antifa as a domestic terrorist organisation on 22 September 2025; condemns politically motivated violence committed by organisations and networks operating under the Antifa label; considers activities under this label to be an international phenomenon that shows both signs of international coordination and hence foreign interference; calls on the Member States to investigate identifiable Antifa organisations and networks suspected of terrorist acts and on the Council to place on the EU terrorist list organisations that meet the criteria of the Council Common Position on the application of specific measures to combat terrorism1a; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Council Common Position of 27 December 2001 on the application of specific measures to combat terrorism (OJ L 344, 28.12.2001, p. 93 ELI: [http://data.europa.eu/eli/compos/2001/931/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/compos/2001/931/oj)).
